notes_for_owner: setup/release_assets needs `python` on PATH (not only python3) and sha256sum. It fetches the tags itself (git fetch --tags --force --unshallow, falling back to git fetch --tags --force, failing soft) because notes.md lists the commits since the previous v* tag. It runs `sha256sum -- *.zip *-setup.exe *.apk *.ipa`, which fails unless the folder holds at least one of each, so the release job must have Python and all four file kinds before assets runs. It writes manifest.json and SHA256SUMS into the release folder and notes.md in the app root; formcompiler also writes SHA256SUMS.txt (overlap, both kept). The notes field (`cat notes.md`) works only if assets runs first in the same checkout, as in formcompiler's release job. Windows builds an NSIS installer (`--bundles nsis`), released as release-dist/formcut-<version>-windows-x86_64-setup.exe beside the portable release-dist/formcut-<version>-windows-x86_64.zip. Tauri signs formcut.exe, the engine sidecar and the installer through the tauri.windows.conf.json formcompiler writes, and formcompiler signs whatever is still unsigned in the zip after the build. setup/build_release passes $FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG to tauri build. On macOS with signing "apple" and the Apple identity, it signs the bundled ffmpeg with APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY (hardened runtime, timestamp, src-tauri/entitlements.plist), builds with hardened runtime so Tauri signs the app and engine sidecar and notarizes and staples when APPLE_ID, APPLE_PASSWORD and APPLE_TEAM_ID are set, and checks the Developer ID, team, runtime flag, staple and spctl on the app unzipped from its zip. Without the identity it stays ad hoc (signingIdentity "-" in tauri.conf.json) and the check requires Signature=adhoc. Linux needs nasm and pkg-config (in linux_packages) for setup/build_lgpl_av's FFmpeg configure. Only the three triples aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc and x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu are accepted. The phone apps are unsigned as before (debug-signed APK, unsigned IPA); they carry the release version, so the version file and formcompiler's version must agree. Linux builds on ubuntu-22.04 (the default for linux-x64) so the AppImage runs on glibc 2.35. Intel Macs are not built (setup/build_macos_app --intel on a Mac).
